notes: S4c-C2: kid-facing effect text for break seals #31-40 (Technique Seal format from content/abilities/abilities.json). Names and effects from the S4b table in drafts/planning/S4-self-defense-powers.md (PR #117); Injured rules from drafts/planning/S4c-injured-status.md. Each text is one sentence under 80 characters, ages 6-9, includes 'and leaves them Injured'. No broken/break/blood/bone/crack/pain/hurt words; only enemies are Injured. ids are proposed (no #31-40 ids exist yet); the Programmer may adjust at import. effectRef is a pointer to the S4b effect, not final effect JSON.

seals.name: Arm Bar Release
seals.text: When your lock ends, it pushes the enemy back and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Slide to the Wrist
seals.text: A lock makes your hits land harder and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Party Flex
seals.text: Each lock you set gives you Focus and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Lock and Drop
seals.text: Your lock ends in a throw that keeps them down and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Catch the Hand
seals.text: A Block catches a quick attacker in a lock and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Wide Release
seals.text: Your release pushes farther, bumps others back and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Steady Hold
seals.text: Holding a lock gives you more time to Counter and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Lock to Takedown
seals.text: Your lock throw keeps them down longer, even shields, and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Release and Go
seals.text: Release sets nearby enemies off-balance, refills Dash and leaves them Injured.

seals.name: Master Hold
seals.text: Your longer lock lands a stronger throw and leaves them Injured.
